name: Daily LinkedIn jobs to Google Sheets (no login, no cookies)

parameters.content:
## Daily LinkedIn jobs into Google Sheets

Every morning this workflow searches LinkedIn for the job titles you list, and adds NEW postings to a Google Sheet. Postings already in the sheet are not duplicated (matched on the LinkedIn job id).

No LinkedIn account, no cookies. Data comes from the [LinkedIn Jobs Scraper](https://apify.com/lergassy/linkedin-jobs-scraper) Actor on Apify.

### Setup (5 minutes)
1. Create a free Apify account and copy your API token (Apify Console > Settings > API & Integrations).
2. In n8n create a **Header Auth** credential: Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`. Select it in the node **Run LinkedIn Jobs Scraper**.
3. Create a Google Sheet with a first row of these column names: `id`, `title`, `company`, `location`, `seniority`, `employmentType`, `salary`, `applicants`, `postedAt`, `url`, `emails`, `foundAt`. Select the sheet in **Add new jobs to sheet** and connect your Google account.
4. Open **Search settings** and type your job titles (comma separated) and location.
5. Click **Execute workflow** once to test, then switch the workflow to Active.

### Cost
About $0.003 per job found (+$0.002 if the posting contains an email). The run is capped at the amount in **maxTotalChargeUsd** (default $1), so a mistake cannot become an expensive day. 25 jobs per run is roughly 8 cents.

### If something fails
When LinkedIn returns only error rows and no jobs, the workflow stops with a clear error message, so you notice it instead of finding an empty sheet a month later.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ keywords: $json.keywords.split(',').map(k => k.trim()).filter(Boolean), location: $json.location, datePosted: $json.datePosted, maxJobsPerQuery: $json.maxJobsPerKeyword, sortBy: 'date', includeDescription: false, includeContacts: true }) }}
